productArea.name: Products
productArea.scope: Search, filter, and sort products or use saved views, then create and edit products, variants, media and alt text, inventory, channel prices, availability, and publication. Product types, attribute definitions, category and collection management, and translations are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Catalog then Products, and open a product for its variants, media, inventory, and channel settings. Follow the detail links to variant and image editors.
Choose Create product from the list and select its product type.
